messages:
Maya: Quick sync on social plan for the launch week. Need final schedule for X + LinkedIn, asset checklist, and who owns webinar follow-ups. Can we land this today?
Jules: Proposed schedule: X day-of AM (teaser), X day-of PM (launch), LinkedIn longform day+1, LinkedIn pulse day+4, reminder X day+6 for webinar. Keep X copy punchy, 1 CTA.
Aaron: For assets: 2 hero images (16:9), 1 short demo gif (10s), 3 carousel cards with stats + 1 short transcript for accessibility. Who's doing final alt copy? @Nina?
Nina: Yep, I'll handle alt copy + 2 variant headlines. Need final images by Tue noon. Can design export PNG + webp.
Maya: Good. Also want to run two CTA variants: 'Try Redwood Inference' -> tracks to demo funnel, and 'See benchmarks' -> blog. We'll A/B on X only.
Jules: Routing suggestion: A clicks -> demo flow (UTM=launch_demo); B clicks -> content flow (UTM=launch_bench). Webinar RSVP should set tag=launch_rsvp.
Aaron: Retarget rules idea: any click OR video view >= 15s -> add to warm audience for 48h. Warm audience gets a direct webinar invite + case study content. Cold audience gets a 14-day nurture sequence.
campaign-bot: Draft posts scheduled: X-launch-2876543210.001, LinkedIn-launch-2876543210.002. Calendar invite created: Webinar - Launch Overview - 2026-05-10 11:00 PDT.
Maya: Inbound lead routing: warm -> SDR queue (launch-warm); RSVPs -> AE queue flagged for 24h follow-up. @Jules can you open the infra ticket for webhook forwards?
Jules: Yep. I'll add the routing matrix to the ticket. snippet for ops: 
```
if user.tag == 'warm': send_to_queue('launch-warm')
if rsvp == true: flag('AE-followup')
```
Nina: Also propose an engagement follow-up sequence post-webinar: day+1 send 60s highlight clip + CTA, day+3 send related case study snippet, day+7 check-in with 'got questions?' CTA. Assign copy owners: Maya day+1, Aaron day+3.
Aaron: I'll prep the case study snippet and short quotes from customers. Need source approval by Thu.
Maya: For measurement: Sam, can you confirm UTM schema and event hooks so we can mark 'warm' correctly? (cc @Jules)
Jules: I'll include event hook spec in ticket (page.engagement.clicked, video.watched.seconds). We'll treat video.watched.seconds >= 15 as warm signal.
Maya: Great. One more: creative variants for LinkedIn longer post should include a short benchmark table image. Nina can create a clean data card.
Nina: On it. Will place designs in Figma and export assets to /marketing/assets/launch/ by Tue 3pm.
Maya: Thanks team. I'll assemble the messaging matrix (3 audiences x 2 CTAs) and drop in the launch doc. Follow-ups: finalize assets Tue 3pm, infra ticket by EOD today, webinar calendar + RSVP flow validated by Fri. :rocket:
Jules: Sounds good. Tagging this thread to the launch doc and closing the loop. :thumbsup:
